headline: Garment workers block Dhaka-Tangail highway, clash with police
summary: Workers of a garment factory blocked the Dhaka-Tangail highway at Chandra Palli Bidyut (Kaliakair) over wage demands; police clashed with protesters and nearby factories declared holidays. Traffic on the highway was disrupted.

headline: Second source for the same Dhaka-Tangail highway blockade in Gazipur
summary: Same event reported separately: highway traffic at a standstill while police tried to clear protesting workers.

headline: Wage protests turn violent in Gazipur, 45 factories close
summary: Garment worker wage protests (demand: Tk 30,000 minimum wage) spread across Gazipur; dozens of factories declared holidays or closed. Local worker incomes and spending may be affected.

headline: At least 80 garment factories shut amid worker protests
summary: Same wave of closures reported separately, covering Gazipur and Savar industrial areas.

headline: Protesting garment workers block Dhaka-Aricha Highway in Savar
summary: Workers from several factories blocked the Dhaka-Aricha highway at Hemayetpur, Savar, over wage demands. Road transport through Savar was disrupted.

headline: At least 40 garment factories in Savar, Ashulia closed indefinitely amid labour unrest
summary: Factories in the Savar and Ashulia industrial belt were declared closed indefinitely under the Labour Act after continued wage unrest. Many local workers may go without pay for a while.

headline: Fire breaks out at Madani Super Market, 4 units working
summary: A fire broke out at Madani Super Market near the Hemayetpur bus stand, Savar, in the evening; four fire service units responded. No casualties were reported at the time.

headline: মাদানী সুপার মার্কেটে আগুন, নিয়ন্ত্রণে চার ইউনিট
summary: একই ঘটনার আলাদা প্রতিবেদন: সাভারের হেমায়েতপুরে মাদানী সুপার মার্কেটে আগুন।

headline: Veggies bring relief, rice prices bite
summary: Dhaka kitchen market review: vegetable and fish prices eased as supply rose, but rice rose again by about Tk 1 per kg across most varieties, after a similar rise the week before.

headline: No plan to hike edible oil prices for now: Muktadir
summary: The commerce minister said the government has no immediate plan to raise edible oil prices after a supplier proposal. Prices are not changed by this statement; it is a policy signal only.
